title: More unrecalled names, Shots and Hoods the banjo player; 111 musicians
summary: Paul struggles over names, finds Shots and the tall banjoist Hoods, and notes there were about 111 musicians on the project.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
